keyFindings.description: The merge of main replaced envoy-and-contracts.yaml (whose envoy filter took packages/contracts/**) with main's ci.yaml router, whose envoy_go filter (ci.yaml:702-730) lists contracts fixtures one by one and not checks-settlement/**. This PR's packages/envoy/internal/cistore/settlement_fixture_test.go:56 reads packages/contracts/fixtures/checks-settlement/listener-rules.json, the fixture shared with daemon/internal/daemon/check_settlement_test.go:56, so a fixture-only change runs the daemon side (test) and skips envoy-go: the cross-check the fixture exists for is lost and ci-ok passes. check-ci-filters.sh does not see it because .github/scripts/ci_job_reads.py RULES lacks the reads; its header requires a test that reads a new file through `..` or starts a new go command to add it. Fix: RULES entries for settlement_fixture_test.go:56, check_settlement_test.go:56 and intake/redelivered_test.go:255 (go build -C ../../../envoy ./cmd/listener ./cmd/dispatch), and 'packages/contracts/fixtures/checks-settlement/**' in envoy_go's filter with its citation.
